attributes.action: Grant planning permission for mixed martial arts academy in vacant building
attributes.additional_details: This petition seeks support for planning permission and change of use to bring a long-term vacant building back to life as a community MMA academy. We need to show the council the clear benefits: improved physical & mental well-being, confidence and resilience for all ages, a safe positive space for local people, working with local organisations to help reduce crime by giving people purpose and direction. Approving this change of use would turn an empty building into a valued community asset.
attributes.background: Bring a vacant building back to life as a community MMA academy for all ages, improving health, fitness, resilience, confidence, and mental well-being. We’ll work with local organisations including Street Life and Recovery Hub to create positive programmes to help reduce crime in our local area.
